audit_protocol.aggregation: Descriptive dependent-split errors; no independent-replication MCSE; not the official weighted leaderboard score
audit_protocol.choice_contract: Complete fixed two-model panel; strict binary canonical choices only; no coercion or row dropping

cohorts.LLMBar: Sensitivity: llmbar- source overlap, not independent new data

audit_protocol.cost_scope: Logical reference labels and cached judgments read, not new API calls, annotations, tokens or money
audit_protocol.cost_sharing: One reference serves both targets; both directions reuse the same two caches; deduplicate unions across methods, targets and cohorts
audit_protocol.fraction_denominator: Total cohort exact-prompt groups; floor each size; audits nested in remaining bank
audit_protocol.human_only_definition: Established method identifier for the reference-only baseline; references need not be human annotations
audit_protocol.identity: Gold-independent unordered-response sample IDs and exact-prompt group IDs are certified by the source loader
audit_protocol.interval_scope: Untruncated asymptotic prompt-cluster population intervals; no empirical coverage claim
audit_protocol.model_scope: Historical dated model caches; no assertion about current models or recovered API invocation settings
audit_protocol.outcome: 1[target canonical choice equals benchmark reference choice]
audit_protocol.point_only_method: audit_residual: no interval, standard error or population variance ratio
audit_protocol.proxy: 1[target canonical choice equals auxiliary canonical choice]; no reference label
audit_protocol.scoring_cost_scope: Held-out reference and target-judgment scoring reads are separate and may overlap inference inputs
audit_protocol.target: Realized target-judge strict reference accuracy in the fixed held-out pool
audit_protocol.weighting: Equal comparison weight; complete exact-prompt groups assigned together across subsets

paired_contrasts: same target, cohort, seed and budget; descriptive means without iid split MCSE
shared_costs: union across both target directions; inference and held-out scoring separated
split_manifest_encoding: indexed-content-identities-v1; zero-based catalog indexes preserve exact ID order
